name: 01519 · Grafton, MA
findings: ZIP 01519 (Grafton) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01519 (Grafton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01519 (Grafton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
